---
pagetitle: "eduschool"
params:
  notion: "fractions_addition"
  support: "quiz"
  tirages: 5
  n: null
  niveau: ""
  humour_ratio: 0.2
  seed: null
output:
  html_document:
    css: !expr system.file("styles", "eduschool.css", package = "eduschool")
    mathjax: default
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
banque = eduschool::questions(params$notion, niveau = params$niveau)
html = knitr::is_html_output()
if (!is.null(params$seed)) set.seed(params$seed)
# Les tirages sont prepares une seule fois : le navigateur ne calcule rien.
tirages = eduschool:::.tirer_questions_quiz_edu(
  banque$questions,
  n = params$n,
  tirages = if (html) params$tirages else 1L,
  melanger = length(eduschool:::.notions_famille(params$notion)) > 0L,
  humour_ratio = params$humour_ratio
)
```

```{r entete, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source(system.file("modeles", "entete.R", package = "eduschool"), local = TRUE)
.entete_edu(params, knitr::is_html_output())
```

**Avant de commencer : feuille + crayon fortement recommandés.** Écris, dessine, barre, essaie : le brouillon fait partie du travail, tu n'as aucune raison de tout faire de tête.

```{r images-html, include=FALSE}
if (html) {
  for (t in seq_along(tirages)) {
    for (i in seq_along(tirages[[t]])) {
      q = tirages[[t]][[i]]
      figure = eduschool::illustrer_question(q)
      if (!is.null(figure)) {
        png = tempfile(fileext = ".png")
        dimensions = attr(figure, "eduschool_dimensions")
        if (is.null(dimensions)) dimensions = c(4, 3)
        ggplot2::ggsave(png, figure, width = dimensions[1],
                        height = dimensions[2], dpi = 130)
        tirages[[t]][[i]]$image = knitr::image_uri(png)
        unlink(png)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r interactif, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (html) {
  # Ne jamais injecter de contenu editorial directement comme HTML ou JavaScript.
  donnees = jsonlite::toJSON(tirages, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null")
  # Transport base64 : aucun caractère <, > ou séquence d'échappement
  # ne peut être interprété par Markdown ou le navigateur.
  donnees = jsonlite::base64_enc(charToRaw(enc2utf8(donnees)))
  cat('<div id="edu-quiz"><div id="edu-questions"></div>',
      '<button id="edu-valider" type="button">Valider mes réponses</button> ',
      '<button id="edu-relancer" type="button">Relancer ce quiz</button> ',
      '<button id="edu-nouveau" type="button">Générer un nouveau quiz</button>',
      '<p id="edu-bilan" aria-live="polite"></p></div>\n')
  cat('<script type="application/json" id="edu-donnees">', donnees, '</script>\n', sep = '')
  cat('<script>\n',
'(() => {
  const brut = atob(document.getElementById("edu-donnees").textContent.trim());
  const octets = Uint8Array.from(brut, c => c.charCodeAt(0));
  const tirages = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(octets));
  const zone = document.getElementById("edu-questions");
  const bilan = document.getElementById("edu-bilan");
  let tour = 0;
  function noeud(type, texte, parent) {
    const el = document.createElement(type);
    el.textContent = texte;
    parent.appendChild(el);
    return el;
  }
  // Mise en forme éditoriale limitée : paragraphes, **gras** et [libellé](lien).
  // Construire des noeuds DOM, jamais de innerHTML avec du JSON.
  function correctionLisible(texte, cible) {
    cible.replaceChildren();
    const lignes = String(texte || "")
      .replace(/\\s*(Je vois|Je sais|J.en déduis|Je calcule)\\s*:/g, "\\n$1 :")
      .split(/\\n+|(?<=\\.)\\s+(?=[A-ZÀ-Ý])/u).map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    lignes.forEach(ligne => {
      const p = document.createElement("p");
      const motifs = /(\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*|\\[([^\\]]+)\\]\\(([^)]+)\\))/g;
      let precedent = 0, match;
      while ((match = motifs.exec(ligne)) !== null) {
        p.appendChild(document.createTextNode(ligne.slice(precedent, match.index)));
        if (match[2]) noeud("strong", match[2], p);
        else {
          const url = match[4];
          // Uniquement des chemins locaux relatifs ; aucune URL externe.
          if (/^(?!\\/|.*\\.\\.)[a-zA-Z0-9_./-]+\\.(html|pdf)(#[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)?$/.test(url)) {
            const a = noeud("a", match[3], p); a.href = url;
          } else p.appendChild(document.createTextNode(match[0]));
        }
        precedent = motifs.lastIndex;
      }
      p.appendChild(document.createTextNode(ligne.slice(precedent)));
      cible.appendChild(p);
    });
  }
  function enonceLisible(q, numero, parent) {
    const titre = document.createElement("h3");
    titre.appendChild(document.createTextNode(numero + ". "));
    const ajouterTexte = texte => {
      String(texte).split(/(?<=\\.)\\s+/u).forEach((phrase, i) => {
        if (i) titre.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));
        titre.appendChild(document.createTextNode(phrase));
      });
    };
    if (!q.presentation || q.presentation.type !== "boite" || !q.enonce.includes("^□")) {
      ajouterTexte(q.enonce);
    } else {
      const morceaux = q.enonce.split("^□");
      morceaux.forEach((morceau, i) => {
        ajouterTexte(morceau);
        if (i < morceaux.length - 1) noeud("sup", "□", titre);
      });
    }
    parent.appendChild(titre);
  }
  function afficher() {
    zone.replaceChildren(); bilan.textContent = "";
    tirages[tour].forEach((q, i) => {
      const bloc = document.createElement("section");
      bloc.className = "edu-question";
      enonceLisible(q, i + 1, bloc);
      if (q.presentation && q.presentation.avertissement) {
        noeud("p", q.presentation.avertissement, bloc).className = "edu-avertissement";
      }
      const reponses = document.createElement("div");
      if (q.image) reponses.className = "edu-reponses-illustrees";
      const choix = document.createElement("div");
      reponses.appendChild(choix);
      if (q.propositions && q.propositions.length) {
        q.propositions.forEach((p, j) => {
          const etiquette = document.createElement("label");
          const bouton = document.createElement("input");
          bouton.type = "radio"; bouton.name = "q" + i;
          bouton.value = p; bouton.id = "edu-q" + i + "-" + j;
          etiquette.appendChild(bouton);
          const masque = q.presentation && q.presentation.masques && q.presentation.masques[p];
          const affichage = q.propositions_affichage && q.propositions_affichage[j];
          noeud("span", " " + (masque || affichage || p), etiquette);
          choix.appendChild(etiquette);
        });
      } else {
        const entree = document.createElement("input");
        entree.type = "text"; entree.setAttribute("aria-label", "Votre reponse");
        choix.appendChild(entree);
      }
      if (q.image) {
        const figure = document.createElement("img");
        figure.src = q.image;
        figure.alt = "Figure associée à la question";
        figure.className = "edu-illustration";
        reponses.appendChild(figure);
      }
      bloc.appendChild(reponses);
      const correction = noeud("div", "", bloc);
      correction.className = "edu-correction";
      correction.hidden = true;
      zone.appendChild(bloc);
    });
    if (window.MathJax && MathJax.typesetPromise) MathJax.typesetPromise([zone]);
    else if (window.MathJax && MathJax.Hub) MathJax.Hub.Queue(["Typeset", MathJax.Hub, zone]);
  }
  document.getElementById("edu-valider").addEventListener("click", () => {
    let bonnes = 0, total = 0;
    tirages[tour].forEach((q, i) => {
      const bloc = zone.children[i];
      const coche = bloc.querySelector("input[type=radio]:checked");
      const saisie = bloc.querySelector("input[type=text]");
      const valeur = coche ? coche.value : (saisie ? saisie.value.trim() : "");
      const juste = valeur === String(q.reponse).trim();
      if (valeur) { total++; if (juste) bonnes++; }
      const correction = bloc.querySelector(".edu-correction");
      correctionLisible((juste ? "Bonne réponse." : "Réponse attendue : " + (q.reponse_affichage || q.reponse) + ".") +
        "\\n" + (q.correction || ""), correction);
      if (q.apart_humour) {
        const apart = noeud("p", q.apart_humour, correction);
        apart.className = "edu-humour";
      }
      correction.hidden = false;
      if (window.MathJax && MathJax.typesetPromise) MathJax.typesetPromise([correction]);
      else if (window.MathJax && MathJax.Hub) MathJax.Hub.Queue(["Typeset", MathJax.Hub, correction]);
    });
    bilan.textContent = bonnes + " reponse(s) correcte(s) sur " + tirages[tour].length +
      " (" + total + " reponse(s) fournies).";
  });
  document.getElementById("edu-relancer").addEventListener("click", () => {
    afficher();
  });
  document.getElementById("edu-nouveau").addEventListener("click", () => {
    tour = (tour + 1) % tirages.length;
    afficher();
  });
  afficher();
})();\n', '</script>\n', sep = '')

}
```

```{r imprimable, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!html) {
  .math_unicode_pdf = function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || !length(x)) return(x)
    exposants = c("⁰" = "0", "¹" = "1", "²" = "2", "³" = "3", "⁴" = "4",
                  "⁵" = "5", "⁶" = "6", "⁷" = "7", "⁸" = "8", "⁹" = "9",
                  "⁺" = "+", "⁻" = "-")
    symboles = c(
      "∅" = "$\\varnothing$", "∈" = "$\\in$", "∉" = "$\\notin$",
      "⊆" = "$\\subseteq$", "⊂" = "$\\subset$",
      "∩" = "$\\cap$", "∪" = "$\\cup$",
      "ℕ" = "$\\mathbb{N}$", "ℤ" = "$\\mathbb{Z}$",
      "ℚ" = "$\\mathbb{Q}$", "ℝ" = "$\\mathbb{R}$",
      "π" = "$\\pi$"
    )
    caracteres = strsplit(as.character(x), "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    resultat = character()
    i = 1L
    while (i <= length(caracteres)) {
      if (caracteres[i] == "^" && i < length(caracteres) && caracteres[i + 1L] == "□") {
        resultat = c(resultat, "$^{\\square}$")
        i = i + 2L
      } else if (caracteres[i] == "□") {
        resultat = c(resultat, "$\\square$")
        i = i + 1L
      } else if (caracteres[i] %in% names(symboles)) {
        resultat = c(resultat, unname(symboles[caracteres[i]]))
        i = i + 1L
      } else if (caracteres[i] %in% names(exposants)) {
        j = i
        while (j <= length(caracteres) && caracteres[j] %in% names(exposants)) j = j + 1L
        puissance = paste(unname(exposants[caracteres[i:(j - 1L)]]), collapse = "")
        resultat = c(resultat, paste0("$^{", puissance, "}$"))
        i = j
      } else {
        resultat = c(resultat, caracteres[i])
        i = i + 1L
      }
    }
    paste0(resultat, collapse = "")
  }
  for (i in seq_along(tirages[[1L]])) {
    q = tirages[[1L]][[i]]
    enonce = .math_unicode_pdf(q$enonce)
    enonce = gsub("\\. +", ".\n\n", enonce)
    cat("\n## Question ", i, "\n\n", enonce, "\n\n", sep = "")
    figure = eduschool::illustrer_question(q)
    if (!is.null(figure)) {
      png = tempfile(fileext = ".png")
      dimensions = attr(figure, "eduschool_dimensions")
      if (is.null(dimensions)) dimensions = c(4, 3)
      ggplot2::ggsave(png, figure, width = dimensions[1],
                      height = dimensions[2], dpi = 130)
      cat("\n\n\\begin{center}\n\n![](", png, "){width=35%}\n\n\\end{center}\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    if (!is.null(q$presentation$avertissement))
      cat("\n*", q$presentation$avertissement, "*\n\n", sep = "")
    if (length(q$propositions)) {
      for (p in q$propositions) {
        masque = q$presentation$masques[[p]]
        j = match(p, q$propositions)
        affichage = q$propositions_affichage[[j]]
        proposition = if (is.null(masque)) affichage else masque
        cat("- ", .math_unicode_pdf(proposition), "\n", sep = "")
      }
      cat("\n")
    } else cat("\nReponse : ........................................\n\n")
  }
  cat("\n\\newpage\n\n# Corrige\n\n")
  for (i in seq_along(tirages[[1L]])) {
    q = tirages[[1L]][[i]]
    cat("\n## Question ", i, "\n\n**Reponse :** ", .math_unicode_pdf(q$reponse_affichage),
        "\n\n**Correction :**\n\n", .math_unicode_pdf(.raisonnement_edu(q$correction)), "\n\n",
        if (!is.null(q$apart_humour)) paste0("*", q$apart_humour, "*\n\n") else "", sep = "")
  }
}
```
